skill.summary: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranki...

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of abm-seo-audit adds a comprehensive standardized SEO audit guide:

- Introduces a detailed SEO audit framework covering technical, on-page, and content quality checks.
- Outlines steps for initial site and business context gathering before the audit.
- Provides tools and methods for detecting schema markup, emphasizing use of Firecrawl for JS-injected data.
- Lists specific, actionable checks for crawlability, indexation, site speed, mobile-friendliness, security, URL structure, and more.
- Includes extensive checklists for titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, images, and internal linking.
- Describes E-E-A-T, content depth, and user engagement as part of content quality evaluation.
- Highlights common SEO issues by site type (SaaS, e-commerce, content/blog).

This version delivers a complete, step-by-step process for diagnosing and improving SEO performance.
